queryName: Beta - MySQL Audit Log Events Connection (Manual)
descriptionText: Flags Azure MySQL Flexible Server instances for manual verification that the 'audit_log_events' parameter includes 'CONNECTION'. This parameter is not a direct attribute on azurerm_mysql_flexible_server; it must be configured via a separate azurerm_mysql_flexible_server_configuration resource. Because the association between server and configuration cannot be automatically verified, this check requires manual confirmation.
